item.title: [7] Universal gates from braiding and fusing anyons on quantum hardware
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Ruben Verresen, Mohsin Iqbal

Authors: Chiu Fan Bowen Lo, Anasuya Lyons, Dan Gresh, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental realization of non-Abelian topological order and anyon braiding on superconducting qubits.

Tags: #topologicalorder #anyons #quantumsimulation

Abstract: A 54-qubit realization of non-Abelian S3 topological order demonstrates that combining anyon braiding with fusion enables universal topological quantum computation.

item.title: [8] Fractional high-Chern insulator in twisted rhombohedral graphene
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Zhida Song, Xiaobo Lu

Authors: Zexu Li, Wenxuan Wang, Fajie Wang, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Important moiré/topological insulator experimental paper relevant to quantum materials.

Tags: #graphene #topology #moiré

Abstract: A rich variety of both integer and fractional high-Chern insulators are observed in a moiré system composed of Bernal bilayer graphene and rhombohedral tetralayer graphene.

item.title: [6] Blue LEDs made from perovskite material shine bright thanks to hydrogen bonds
item.content:encoded:
Authors: Authors not available in source RSS

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Perovskite materials work, potentially relevant to broader quantum materials context.

Tags: #perovskite #LED

Abstract: Blue light-emitting diodes (LEDs) are needed for high-definition displays with wide colour range. Efficient, stable and colour-saturated blue LEDs containing emitters made of perovskites have now been fabricated by adding isomeric molecules that generate a network of hydrogen bonds, stabilizing the octahedral structure of the perovskite crystal.
